# Quiet Places

> Bilingual directory of calm towns, artist residencies, wellness hubs, and retreats in Mexico.

Place profiles link to public sources and each place's own contact channels.

## Pages and reference files

- [About Quiet Places](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/)
- [Presentación en español](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/es/)
- [English directory](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/)
- [Directorio en español](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/es/)
- [Relocation guides](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/guides/)
- [Residency program](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/match/)
- [Directory sources and context](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/llms.txt)
- [Full directory context](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/quiet-places/directory/llms-full.txt)
